author: Bonsai
description: A file used to declare the XML namespace prefix and icon of a Bonsai library
name: Bonsai Library Info

prefix.description: The XML namespace prefix used for operators of the library in workflow files.

icon.description:
The built-in editor icon used for operators of the library, or the full name of a custom icon resource.
Built-in icons:
  Audio       Audio processing
  CSharp      C# scripting
  Daq         Data acquisition
  Dsp         Digital signal processing
  Hid         Human interface devices
  IO          Input and output
  ML          Machine learning
  Net         Networking
  Neuro       Neuroscience
  Numerics    Numerical computation
  Physics     Physics simulation
  Reactive    Reactive operators
  Scripting   Scripting
  Shaders     Graphics shaders
  Video       Video
  Vision      Computer vision
  Visualizer  Visualizers
